sections.label: Transforming logistics industry productivity
sections.summary: Government and industry work together to raise productivity and job quality and reduce urban logistics traffic congestion.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: To transform the logistics industry, the Government and industry are working together to raise productivity and job quality, as well as reduce traffic congestion in our urban logistics sector.

sections.label: SPRING and IMDA mall pilots
sections.summary: SPRINGSingapore and IMDA facilitate loading bay management and in-mall distribution, with pilots at Tampines Mall, Bedok Mall, IMM and Westgate.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: For example, at the business-to-business level, SPRINGSingapore and IMDA are facilitating more loading bay management and in-mall distribution operations that will reduce congestion at and around the loading bay at our shopping malls.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: SPRINGSingapore and IMDA have also started pilots at Tampines Mall, Bedok Mall, IMM and Westgate.

sections.label: Pilot results and parcel lockers
sections.summary: Pilots cut average parking time from 24 to seven minutes, and a nationwide federated parcel locker network is being rolled out.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: Through these pilots, the average parking time has been reduced from 24 minutes to seven minutes for in-mall distribution users.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: With these improvements in turnaround time, residents benefit from less traffic congestion immediately outside the malls, while the truck drivers themselves are able to make more deliveries within the same day.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: It is estimated that almost 50% of the parcel volume going into Tampines and Bedok Malls are now handled through such in-mall distribution operating channels.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: We plan to roll out in-mall distribution channels to more malls progressively once we get these pilots started well and learn some lessons from there.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: In the business-to-consumer space, in tandem with the rapid growth of e-commerce, the Government is rolling out a nationwide, federated parcel locker network to ease the last-mile delivery challenges for small parcels.

sections.label: JTC District Logistics Networks study
sections.summary: JTC is exploring the feasibility of implementing District Logistics Networks within new industrial estates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: Lastly, JTC is also exploring the feasibility of implementing District Logistics Networks within our new industrial estates.
